owner.description: The full name of the person responsible for this SmokePing installation.

contact.description: Email address for alerts and general contact.

mailhost.description: Hostname or IP of the SMTP server to use for sending emails.

imgcache.description: Directory where generated PNG images are stored.

imgurl.description: URL path prefix for accessing the cached images.

datadir.description: Directory where RRDtool database files are stored.

piddir.description: Directory where the PID file is stored.

cgiurl.description: Full URL to the SmokePing CGI script.

smokemail.description: Path to the email template for alert notifications.

tmail.description: Path to the tmail script or binary.

syslogfacility.description: Syslog facility to use for logging.

alerts_to.description: Email address to send alert notifications to.

alerts_from.description: Email address alerts are sent from.

database_step.description: Step size in seconds for data collection.

database_pings.description: Number of pings sent per step.

presentation_template.description: Path to the HTML template file.

presentation_htmltitle.description: Whether to include the <title> tag in HTML output.

presentation_graphborders.description: Whether to draw borders around graphs.

presentation_literalsearch.description: Whether to treat filter menu queries as literal strings instead of regex.

overview_width.description: Width of the overview charts in pixels.

overview_height.description: Height of the overview charts in pixels.

overview_range.description: Default time range for the overview charts.

detail_width.description: Width of the detailed charts in pixels.

detail_height.description: Height of the detailed charts in pixels.

detail_unison_tolerance.description: Tolerance for unison alignment in seconds.

probes_fping_binary.description: Path to the fping binary used by the FPing probe.

slaves_secrets.description: Path to the secrets file for slave authentication.

targets_probe.description: Default probe to use for targets.

targets_menu.description: Menu name for the top-level target group.

targets_title.description: Title for the top-level target group.

targets_remark.default: Welcome to the SmokePing website of Insert Company Name Here. \
targets_remark.description: Remark/description text for the top-level target group.

targets_fedora_menu.description: Menu name for the Fedora target group.

targets_fedora_title.description: Title for the Fedora target group.

targets_fedoraprojectorg_menu.description: Menu name for the fedoraproject.org target.

targets_fedoraprojectorg_host.description: Hostname or IP for the fedoraproject.org target.

targets_docsfedoraprojectorg_menu.description: Menu name for the docs.fedoraproject.org target.

targets_docsfedoraprojectorg_host.description: Hostname or IP for the docs.fedoraproject.org target.

targets_planetfedora_menu.description: Menu name for the planet.fedoraproject.org target.

targets_planetfedora_host.description: Hostname or IP for the planet.fedoraproject.org target.
